title: Wire default .pudicus.yml and install to write the config into target repos
description: Local installer hardening completed and tested: keep foreign/legacy/edited/disabled hooks intact, reject configured core.hooksPath rather than replacing hook managers, verify managed-hook content hashes before refresh, support linked worktrees and minimal PATH. Fourteen installer regressions pass. Existing config files remain preserved. Source publication and adoption in other projects are tracked separately; original implementation acceptance remains closed.
